summary: Define internal full notice producer/snapshot models and conformance fixtures without activating notice operations.

replay.detail: No admitted claim, projection or replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database schema change; standalone client JSON Schema definitions are additive.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or admission rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Generated TypeScript/Effect model definitions include internal notice types. No Resource, action, operation, collection or capability is added; Rust/Swift notice model emission is not included.

downtime.detail: No daemon deployment or restart required.

manual.detail: No notice producer or client activation step.

recovery.detail: Revert the additive definitions and regenerate clients; no stored state is affected.
